[Tests] cover the `--help` and `--version` paths

The pargs migration added an early return in `getOptions` and another in `run`
for when `help()` has already handled the invocation, and nothing exercised
either - two statements, branches and lines that the previous commit reported
as lost.

`help()` reports through `console.log`, which is also how tape emits TAP, so
the capture has to be restored before any assertion or its result line is
swallowed; that is what the local `captureLog` helper is for. `process.exitCode`
is saved and restored around each one, since `help()` sets it even under
`exit: false` and it would otherwise become the exit code of the whole run.

248 passing, and the uncovered counts are back to where they were before the
migration: 26 statements, 40 branches, 1 function, 16 lines.
